items.title: Power Automate: AI-assisted UI Automation repair
items.description: A new agentic debug run feature will be available in the flow designer. The UI automation repair interface launches while the flow is running, validating each selector used in the flow. It then proposes a new selector in case an existing one does not work as expected, after the user captures the respective element for reference.

items.title: Power Pages: Track Power Pages performance and usage with monitor hub
items.description:
Power Pages is integrated into the monitor hub. This integration empowers site owners, makers, and administrators to access performance and usage insights directly within the monitor hub of the Power Platform admin center.
Metrics available
The following metrics will be surfaced in monitor hub:
•	Session count: Tracks the number of sessions.
•	Session duration: Measures the average time spent in a session.
•	Page load time: Captures the time it takes for a web page to fully load (P75).
•	Error r

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
items.description: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Allow users to translate PDF documents into their preferred language
items.description: Users will be able to translate full PDF documents directly within the native PDF viewer in Microsoft Edge. The translated document opens in a new tab, making it easier to access content in their preferred language.  Admins can control availability to this feature using the TranslateEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Decline a call with a message on Mobile
items.description: Users can quickly decline an incoming Teams call and send a predefined message to the caller at the same time. From the incoming call screen, users can select a message such as letting the caller know they're unavailable or will call back, providing helpful context without having to answer the call or separately open a chat.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in DoD
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to the Microsoft 365 Department of Defense (DoD) environment, providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the DoD environment.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Knowledge
items.description:
Knowledge sources ground your agent's responses in enterprise data. When you add knowledge sources, agents can use enterprise data from Power Platform, Dynamics 365 data, websites, and external systems. By using knowledge sources, your agents can provide relevant information and insights for your customers.
You can incorporate knowledge sources into agents during their initial creation, or add them after the agent is created.
Published agents that contain knowledge use the configured knowledge s

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Improve rental operations and fulfillment
items.description: As organizations expand beyond one-time asset sales to rental, leasing, and servitization business models, new rental management capabilities help them manage and monetize the assets they build, own, and operate throughout the rental lifecycle. In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, organizations can manage availability and reservations, fulfillment, delivery and pickup, inspections, and returns. These capabilities can help improve fleet utilization, reduce idle time, and streamline the moveme

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
items.description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
items.description: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
items.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook for Mac
items.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on Mac devices.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with list form in Workflows
items.description: Starts a workflow with a form to collect the information you need to run the rest of your workflow.

items.title: Outlook: Microsoft Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments
items.description: When composing an email in Outlook for Mac, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be automatically applied or recommended based on the sensitivity labels of attached files. This helps users consistently protect sensitive information, reduces manual labeling effort, and supports organizational compliance requirements by aligning email protection with the sensitivity of attached content.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachment for iOS and Android
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance from attachments. When users attach files with sensitivity labels, Outlook can automatically apply or recommend an email sensitivity label based on organizational policy settings. This helps organizations maintain consistent data classification and protection while reducing manual labeling effort.

items.title: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
items.description: OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classi

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
items.description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

items.title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
items.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Helps You Discover People
items.description: Now Copilot Search can return matching people for your broader people search queries. Allowing you to discover, disambiguate, and explore known and new people to contact. Discover Whether you're looking for people with a specific skill like "Project leadership" or "Artificial Intelligence" Copilot Search can help you explore potential contacts through the People data source. Disambiguate When there are multiple people matching in exact name, email, or alias Copilot Search will help you disambigu

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Suggested References in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Users can now quickly enrich their Copilot Notebook with relevant Suggested References based on recent user work activity. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
items.description: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.

items.title: Power Pages: First Class Support for Connector APIs in Power Pages
items.description:
Native connectors support through Power Pages will allow organizations to securely connect their websites/portals directly to enterprise systems such as SQL, SAP, and Oracle, without building or maintaining custom integration layers.
This capability is especially valuable for regulated and enterprise customers such as banking and financial services, who need to surface data from systems hosted behind corporate firewalls. By leveraging the Power Platform on-premises data gateway and connector fra

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Expand localization in LATAM countries for Argentina
items.description:
With the release of Argentina, we are finalizing the LATAM expansion. Out-of-the-box localization is now available for 14 countries in the region through the cross-LATAM localization framework, in addition to Brazil and Mexico.
The country localization indicated below is provisional and may change prior to general availability. Additionally, not all of the following capabilities might be available for preview.
The Argentina-specific scope for this release includes:

Sales tax (VAT and provincial

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sustainability: Restate previously calculated emissions
items.description:
Organizations can recalculate previously calculated emissions using a new restatement capability in Dynamics 365 Sustainability. Users can create a new calculation result while preserving the original result, helping maintain traceability between the original and restated emissions.
Users can identify the calculation being restated, capture the reason for the restatement, and retain the calculation history. This supports scenarios such as correcting errors, incorporating improved activity data o

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Configure actions on task grid
items.description:
This feature extends Task Grid View Templates so administrators can configure both task columns and the visibility of supported task-grid actions in one place. Administrators can show or hide individual actions across task-grid views, the toolbar, row-level controls, and the task context menu.
Configurable actions include views such as Board, Timeline, Charts, Assignments, People, and Goals; toolbar commands such as Baseline, Conditional Formatting, and export; and task-management actions such a

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Optimized Customer data entities
items.description:
Dynamics 365 Finance introduces a set of optimized customer data entities that provide more focused options for integrating customer information. Instead of relying on a single broad customer entity, organizations can work with purpose-specific entities for core customer information, extended customer attributes, postal addresses, electronic contact information, and customer associations.
The optimized entities support both Data management import/export and OData integration scenarios, enabling

items.title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
items.description: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
items.description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered int

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Support trade counter sales in POS
items.description:
Trade Counter POS is a collection of capabilities for Dynamics 365 Commerce Point of Sale. Businesses can adopt the capabilities individually to support their trade counter operations rather than enable a single, all-or-nothing experience.
Counter associates can find customers, organizations, and products quickly. They can review customer history, credit terms, and contract pricing, and use product attributes to identify items that meet the customer's requirements.
Associates can build and manag

items.title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
items.description: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
items.description: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Boost contact center efficiency with real-time streaming analytics
items.description:
Real-time streaming analytics is built into the new supervisor application. An advanced streaming engine keeps metrics up to date with near-instant updates, allowing supervisors to view the latest data without refreshing the dashboard.
Key capabilities include:

Continuous, streaming dashboards: Monitor mission-critical KPIs such as queue backlog, service level, abandon rate, and representative presence in near real time. Visual alerts highlight anomalies as they occur.
Full-screen wallboards: D

items.title: Outlook: Multiple Intune Accounts in Outlook for Android
items.description: Multiple MAM (Mobile Application Management) Intune Accounts will now be supported in Outlook for Android. Only one MDM (Mobile Device Management) account will be supported at a time per device.

items.title: PowerPoint: Clear view-only messaging
items.description: When you open a presentation you don't have permission to edit, PowerPoint now shows a clear "Viewing Only" message bar. It explains that the file is view-only, shows who created it, and tells you to contact the owner if you need more access.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax. Create richer, more readable messages while staying in the Markdown authoring experience.

items.title: Planner: Task History
items.description: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.

items.title: Planner: Conditional Coloring
items.description: Conditional Coloring highlight tasks based on selected criteria, making priorities, status, and important task details easier to spot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
items.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calendar view on the panel device. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

items.title: Planner: Capacity view
items.description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and co

items.title: Outlook: Reply with a Template in Rules
items.description: You can now create a rule that automatically replies to incoming messages with a template you've set up. Set the conditions you care about and pick the template, and Outlook handles the response for you. It's a simple way to send consistent replies without typing the same thing over and over. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
items.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Supercharge your workflows with computer use
items.description: Add resilient, AI-powered UI automation directly into your workflows with computer use tools. Makers can build reusable, goal-oriented automations that adapt dynamically to website or app changes, while admins maintain governance through access controls, hosted browser management, and environment-level permissions. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Companion apps - Copilot prompts in the Files app now available for Copilot Chat users
items.description: The Files companion app, part of the Microsoft 365 companion apps suite on the Windows taskbar, now surfaces AI-powered Copilot file prompts for Copilot Chat users. Previously available only to Microsoft 365 Copilot licensees, this update extends contextual file prompts to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users, enabling them to discover and interact with relevant files through intelligent suggestions. Users can find their most relevant files faster and take action on them directly from the Files app.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
items.description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
items.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning iss

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Import HRIS data in Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center
items.description: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.
